name_boundary_caution: Andropogon ischaemum var. barbinodis is a synonym of Bothriochloa barbinodis, not of B. ischaemum. Never map historical varieties from their first two words alone.
infraspecific_caution: POWO treats var. perforata, var. palmeri, and var. schlumbergeri as synonyms of species B. barbinodis; Texas regional keys historically recognize pit-bearing var. perforata. Preserve old determinations and original rank.
native_range_audit: DEFERRED — NOT REVIEWED; canonical existing native statuses untouched
photo_and_specimen_identity: HOLD — accepted taxon does not certify each individual photo/specimen
hybrid_provenance: HOLD — no individual hybrid status established
install_decision: Existing accepted learner; no duplicate cane bluestem or historic-variety species cards

decisions.subject: Bothriochloa barbinodis (Lag.) Herter
decisions.proposed_decision: ACCEPTED species, Poaceae; retain exact current learner binomial and authorship
decisions.detail: Published 1940; POWO/WCVP recognizes at species rank.

decisions.subject: Andropogon barbinodis Lag.
decisions.proposed_decision: HOMOTYPIC synonym of B. barbinodis, not a separate accepted card

decisions.subject: Andropogon ischaemum var. barbinodis (Lag.) Desv.
decisions.proposed_decision: HOMOTYPIC synonym of B. barbinodis; preserve full variety epithet and author to prevent false KR mapping
decisions.detail: Historic combination uses the ischaemum species epithet but POWO places its type with B. barbinodis.

decisions.subject: Bothriochloa barbinodis var. perforata (Trin. ex E.Fourn.) Gould
decisions.proposed_decision: HETEROTYPIC synonym of accepted B. barbinodis under POWO/WCVP
decisions.detail: Published 1959; regional pit-based varietal usage is separately noted, not a second species.

decisions.subject: Bothriochloa barbinodis var. palmeri (Hack.) De Wet
decisions.proposed_decision: HETEROTYPIC synonym of accepted B. barbinodis

decisions.subject: Bothriochloa barbinodis var. schlumbergeri (E.Fourn.) De Wet
decisions.proposed_decision: HETEROTYPIC synonym of accepted B. barbinodis
decisions.detail: Listed under heterotypic synonyms; not a separate learner card.

decisions.subject: Bothriochloa perforata (Trin. ex E.Fourn.) Herter
decisions.proposed_decision: HETEROTYPIC synonym of B. barbinodis, not a separately accepted species
decisions.detail: Do not infer species distinction from old binomial.

decisions.subject: Dichanthium barbinode (Lag.) D.L.Fu
decisions.proposed_decision: HOMOTYPIC 2024 combination under POWO synonymy; accepted destination B. barbinodis
decisions.detail: Do not automatically change genus because a new combination was published.

decisions.subject: Bothriochloa ischaemum (L.) Keng
decisions.proposed_decision: Separate accepted species; not a synonym of B. barbinodis
decisions.detail: Retain existing invasive-comparison KR card independently from native cane bluestem.

decisions.subject: Pitted versus unpitted glumes in B. barbinodis
decisions.proposed_decision: FNA documents occasional lower-glume pits without other distinguishing characters
decisions.detail: The pit is a historic infraspecific key character, not by itself proof of a different accepted species.

decisions.subject: Auto-map Andropogon ischaemum var. barbinodis to Bothriochloa ischaemum
decisions.proposed_decision: REJECT false parent-binomial mapping; destination is B. barbinodis
decisions.detail: Name must be resolved at full rank and author, not only first two words.

decisions.subject: Create distinct learner species from B. barbinodis var. perforata / palmeri
decisions.proposed_decision: REJECT duplicate accepted species cards under POWO/WCVP
decisions.detail: Historical infraspecific labels remain searchable source aliases.

decisions.subject: Individual source photographs and herbarium determinations labelled cane bluestem or pitted bluestem
decisions.proposed_decision: Do not assert independent specimen identification from synonymy alone
decisions.detail: Mature lower glume, true culm nodes, paired spikelets and specimen provenance may be needed; existing gallery untouched.

decisions.subject: Individual Bothriochloa hybrid or introgression status
decisions.proposed_decision: No specimen-level hybrid ancestry, cultivar or parentage conclusion without explicit supporting evidence
decisions.detail: Published genus-level hybrid history does not identify the learner's individual plants.

decisions.subject: Historical regional rank var. perforata versus POWO species-wide circumscription
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve historic variety determinations; use accepted B. barbinodis for canonical identity
decisions.detail: Regional Texas flora keys pit/no-pit as varieties; FNA reports sporadic pits without other distinctions; POWO synonymizes variety.

decisions.subject: 2024 Dichanthium barbinode genus circumscription
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve published alternative combination as homotypic synonym; no genus migration without backbone change
decisions.detail: A published genus combination exists, but POWO/WCVP still accepts Bothriochloa barbinodis; no independent phylogenetic adjudication undertaken.
